# SB-1019 Safety bulletin: quench oil fire risk

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P3, line P3-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L4-SB03

Hazard description
There is an elevated quench oil fire risk associated with excessive combustible particulates in the shot blast cabinet exhaust path and quench system ventilation. The dust collector pressure drop alarm for Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P3-L4-SB03) is 1510 Pa. When the dust collector is restricted at this level, extraction efficiency is reduced, resulting in higher particulate loading in the cabinet atmosphere and oil mist entrainment into the quench stream. Oil-saturated dust and insufficient ventilation increase the probability of auto-ignition or flame propagation during quench operations. This bulletin communicates immediate actions and controls to mitigate ignition risk.

Affected equipment
- EQ-P3-L4-SB03 (Heat Treat shot blast cabinet #3 and associated quench oil system).
- Any auxiliary ventilation or filtration equipment serving the cabinet as referenced in operating procedures.

Required controls
- Cease quench operations for EQ-P3-L4-SB03 until the dust collector condition is evaluated and returned to service per maintenance guidance.
- Isolate quench oil supply and remove hot work sources in the immediate area while combustible load is being addressed.
- Inspect and clean the dust collector and downstream ductwork following SOP-P3-L4-02. Ensure verification of dust removal prior to restart.
- Follow maintenance and inspection sequence in MM-P3-L4-SB03 for filter change-out and fan performance checks; document work in the equipment log.
- Implement enhanced Housekeeping: remove oil-saturated debris from accessible surfaces using approved methods and contain waste for proper disposal.
- Ensure firefighting and spill response equipment are immediately available and personnel are briefed on response per SB-1038.
- Record alarm events and corrective actions in the shift log; escalate unresolved alarms to maintenance and safety engineering.

Effective date
Effective date: Implementation actions commence immediately; consult MM-P3-L4-SB03, SB-1038, and SOP-P3-L4-02 for procedural details and authorization to return EQ-P3-L4-SB03 to service.
